stories.headline: Drought hits Maharashtra's rabi sowing: 15.69 lakh hectares planted vs 57.8 lakh average
stories.summary: An official report says rabi sowing in Maharashtra covered only 15.69 lakh hectares by November 23, against a five-year average of 57.80 lakh hectares and 25.99 lakh hectares a year ago. Drought has been declared in 310 of the state's 358 tehsils. Kolhapur, Nagpur and Nashik divisions have the best coverage.
stories.why_it_matters: A weak winter crop in a big farm state can push up prices of wheat, gram and other rabi crops next year.
stories.note: Single source: All India Radio (official state report). Its percentage figures were inconsistent, so only hectares are used.

image.alt: Cracked, dry farmland beside a shrunken river

impact.why: A poor rabi crop could raise food prices and hurt rural incomes.

stories.headline: IORA senior officials meet in Delhi today ahead of Friday's foreign ministers' meeting
stories.summary: A two-day meeting of the Indian Ocean Rim Association's Committee of Senior Officials begins in New Delhi today, followed by the 25th IORA Council of Ministers on Friday. On Tuesday the EU and IORA held their first high-level roundtable on maritime security in Delhi, on piracy, trafficking and protecting sea lanes.

stories.headline: 11 killed in bus-truck crash in UAE's Ras Al Khaimah; Indians among the dead
stories.summary: The UAE Interior Ministry says 11 people died when a passenger bus and a truck collided on Al Watan Road in Ras Al Khaimah, and an investigation has begun. India's consulate in Dubai confirmed that some Indian nationals were among the dead and set up a 24/7 helpline (800-46342).
stories.note: Single source: All India Radio, citing the UAE Interior Ministry and India's consulate in Dubai.

stories.headline: Putin says retaliation is 'inevitable' as Ukraine keeps hitting Russian refineries
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin says Kyiv has kept striking Russian oil refineries despite US President Trump asking it to stop, and that Russia will retaliate. Kyiv says it will stop hitting Russian energy sites only when Moscow does the same. Attacks had eased after Trump declared an energy ceasefire in mid-October but resumed late that month.
stories.why_it_matters: More strikes on refineries and power plants could cut Russian fuel exports and keep oil prices volatile.
stories.note: Single source: Al Jazeera (with Reuters). The retaliation threat is Putin's own statement.

image.alt: A Russian oil plant lit up at night, with a Russian flag on top (file photo)

impact.why: Attacks on Russian refineries and threats of reprisals add supply risk.

stories.headline: Houthis say they will hit Jeddah and Saudi ports if coalition attacks Hodeidah
stories.summary: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen told civilians to leave the Red Sea port of Hodeidah for their safety. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree says the group will target Jeddah and other Saudi Red Sea ports if Hodeidah is attacked. Iran's IRGC chief also warned future wars could reach beyond the region.
stories.why_it_matters: A wider Red Sea fight would threaten a key route for oil tankers and ships heading to and from India.
stories.note: Claim by the Houthis; coalition order and threat reported by Al Jazeera only.

impact.why: Threats to Saudi Red Sea ports raise the risk to oil shipments.

stories.headline: Update: Shenzhou-24 lifts off with Pakistan's first astronaut, bound for Tiangong
stories.summary: China's Shenzhou-24 launched at 8:18 am Beijing time on Wednesday from Jiuquan on a Long March-2F rocket. Pakistani pilot Muhammad Zeeshan Ali becomes the first foreign astronaut to visit China's Tiangong station, flying with commander Tang Hongbo and engineer Wu Yi. He will stay five to 10 days doing experiments. Change since last edition: the launch has now happened.

stories.headline: US jury convicts Huawei of trade secret theft conspiracy and bank fraud
stories.summary: A US jury found China's Huawei guilty of conspiring to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud, but acquitted it of the most serious charge, racketeering conspiracy. Prosecutors said Huawei stole technology from rivals and hid business in sanctioned countries such as Iran and North Korea. The case began in 2018.
stories.why_it_matters: The verdict adds to US-China tech tensions as Washington weighs fresh trade measures.
stories.note: Single source: Al Jazeera (AP and Reuters report).

stories.headline: Israel's Eisenkot wins Lieberman as first coalition partner in bid to replace Netanyahu
stories.summary: Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party (21 seats) says it agreed a coalition pact with Avigdor Lieberman's Our Home party (7 seats), the first such alliance since the October 27 election. Eisenkot has until December 6 to form a government; Netanyahu stays caretaker prime minister. A majority needs 61 of 120 seats.

stories.headline: Rupee reopens after holiday; offshore quote near 92.9 as Asian stocks slide
stories.summary: Indian currency markets reopen today after Tuesday's Gurpurab holiday. The rupee last closed at 92.92 per dollar on Monday, and offshore quotes are near 92.90. The dollar index is flat at about 103.9 ahead of US core PCE inflation and GDP data later today. Heavy selling in Asian chip stocks could weigh on the rupee if foreign funds pull money from Indian shares.
stories.why_it_matters: The rupee's open shows how much of the global risk-off mood spills into India after a two-day gap.
stories.note: Rupee close confirmed by PTI and Business Standard; live quotes from Yahoo Finance.

impact.why: Risk-off in Asian markets could drive foreign outflows from Indian shares.
Dollar waits for US PCE inflation data due later today.

stories.headline: Australian inflation jumps to 4.9% in October, above forecasts; Aussie dollar firms
stories.summary: Australia's consumer prices rose 4.9% in the year to October, up from 4.3% and above the 4.7% forecast, the statistics bureau says. Underlying trimmed-mean inflation rose to 3.8% from 3.6%, with housing and electricity costs the biggest drivers. The Australian dollar rose about 0.2% after the data, Reuters reports.
stories.why_it_matters: Hot inflation keeps pressure on the Reserve Bank of Australia, which has already raised rates by 1.25 points this year.

impact.why: Higher-than-expected inflation raises the chance of more RBA rate hikes.

stories.headline: Asian chip stocks tumble: Taiwan down 5%, Kospi 4.5%, Nikkei 2.9% as Indian markets reopen
stories.summary: Asian markets fell sharply early on Wednesday as the tech rally faded and worries about possible new US tariffs grew. Taiwan's index was down about 5.2% and South Korea's Kospi about 4.5%, while Japan's Nikkei lost 2.9%; Hong Kong rose 0.7%. US S&P 500 futures were down about 0.6%. Indian stocks reopen today after Tuesday's holiday, last closing with a 1.75% Nifty fall on Monday.
stories.why_it_matters: Indian shares missed Tuesday's chip rally and now open into a fresh Asian selloff, so IT and metal stocks may come under pressure.

image.alt: A man in silhouette in front of a stock price board in Tokyo

impact.why: A sharp Asian tech selloff is likely to weigh on Indian shares at the open.
Global chip and AI stocks are falling, hitting tech sentiment.
US futures are lower after the Nasdaq's 1.5% drop.

stories.headline: Update: Nasdaq closes 1.5% lower as chip index sinks 7.9%; Dow gains 0.9% to 50,019
stories.summary: The Nasdaq ended down 1.48% at 23,733.54 and the S&P 500 fell 0.50% to 7,201.09, while the Dow rose 0.85% to 50,018.70. Nvidia lost 5.9% and the Philadelphia chip index 7.9% as investors weighed Jensen Huang's return as CEO, and Anthropic fell below its IPO price. Change since last edition: final closing numbers; chip losses deepened.

impact.why: Chip stocks gave back a large part of Monday's rally.
Investors weighed governance questions after Huang's return.

stories.headline: Dell beats forecasts with $54.9bn revenue and a record $132bn AI server backlog
stories.summary: Dell's quarterly revenue more than doubled to $54.94 billion, against about $49.3 billion expected, and adjusted earnings were $9.45 a share. It ended the quarter with a record $132.3 billion AI server backlog, raised its full-year AI server forecast to $78 billion and approved a $25 billion buyback. Its shares rose about 4% after hours.
stories.why_it_matters: Strong AI server demand is a sign that big tech spending on AI is still growing.

impact.why: Results and guidance well above forecasts, plus a big buyback.

stories.headline: Update: Brent settled 2% higher at $91.40 on Hormuz attacks; gold eases to $3,547
stories.summary: Brent crude settled up about $2 at $91.40 a barrel on Tuesday after new attacks on ships in and around the Strait of Hormuz, then slipped to about $90.8 in Asian trade. Gold futures eased 0.4% to about $3,547 an ounce early on Wednesday, extending this week's fall. Change since last edition: final oil settlement and new gold low.
stories.note: Brent settlement confirmed by Yahoo Finance data and The Nation (Thailand); gold from Yahoo Finance only.

impact.why: Attacks on shipping near Hormuz keep a risk premium in oil.
Gold keeps slipping as traders bet on higher US rates.

stories.headline: China Southern unit Xiamen Airlines signs deal to buy 50 Boeing 737-8 jets
stories.summary: China Southern Airlines says its unit Xiamen Airlines agreed to buy 50 Boeing 737-8 planes, worth about $7.4 billion at list price before a large discount, in a stock exchange filing. It is Boeing's first major order from China in almost a decade, after a May Trump-Xi summit where China committed to 200 jets.
stories.note: Single source: Al Jazeera (Reuters report), citing China Southern's exchange filing.

impact.why: A rare big Chinese order for Boeing.

stories.headline: DeepHealth wins US clearance for AI that predicts breast cancer risk from 3D mammograms
stories.summary: RadNet's DeepHealth says the US FDA cleared Mammo Risk, AI software that estimates a woman's three- to five-year breast cancer risk from her existing 3D mammogram, with no extra scans. The company calls it the first FDA-cleared image-based risk tool for 3D mammography. It was trained on 220,000 studies and is now on sale to US providers.
stories.why_it_matters: Doctors could use it to decide who needs extra screening, earlier than questionnaire-based risk models allow.
stories.note: Single source: DeepHealth press release; 'first' is the company's claim.

stories.headline: Samsung launches first gaming monitor with a 1,100Hz refresh rate
stories.summary: Samsung says its 27-inch Odyssey G6 (G60H) is the world's first gaming monitor to reach 1,100Hz, in HD mode, or 600Hz at QHD resolution. It goes on sale in the US from December at $899.99.
stories.note: Single source: Samsung newsroom; 'world's first' is the company's claim.

forex_results.title: CB Consumer Confidence
forex_results.why: Confidence jumped to its highest since January 2025, well above forecasts, which supports the dollar and Fed hike bets.

forex_results.title: CPI y/y
forex_results.why: Inflation rose to 4.9%, above the 4.7% forecast, raising the chance of more RBA hikes and supporting the Aussie dollar.

forex_results.title: CPI m/m
forex_results.why: Prices rose 0.5% in October, above the 0.4% forecast, driven by fuel and housing costs.
